entries.text: Daily Plan 2026-08-18: |   BTC WAIT |   GOLD WAIT |   SPX WAIT |   ⚠ 2 consecutive losses — reduce size

DAILY-CHECK 2026-08-18: health 8/8, fleet AGREES (both gates 70, engines identical). TOP ISSUE: VPS is at 3/3 consecutive losses but every surface reports halted:false — the breaker is evaluated lazily inside process_signal (mt5_bridge.py:1361), so the flag is only set at the next trade attempt. Worse, consecutive_losses clears ONLY on a win (mt5_bridge.py:323) while the halt blocks new entries, so once the peer's open XAUUSD long closes, a losing close wedges the box permanently and needs a manual reset. Every source found frames a loss-streak halt as time-boxed (24-48h), not "until a win". Also: DUPLICATE gate verdict COSTING MONEY (+23.63R over 16 resolved, 81% would have won, 15/16 XAUUSD MOMENTUM) — but those are one correlated gold leg behind the open Aug-11 position, not 16 independent samples. Also: tv_daily_plan.py cron has failed every logged run since 2026-08-07 (UnicodeEncodeError on the ⚠ warning at line 301, cp1252 stdout), and its /api/daily-plan fetch is unauthenticated against a session-gated route so every saved plan carries price:null. Exa search API key is returning 401.

DAILY-CHECK 2026-08-18: /api/rejection-evidence counts scored ROWS as episodes — 768 rows are 113 episodes. Sample sizes inflated 2-4x and two verdicts flip: MIN_RR 155 resolved/-19.09R EARNING ITS KEEP becomes 40 resolved/+2.75R (inside the noise band), DUPLICATE 16 resolved/+23.63R COSTING MONEY becomes 3 resolved TOO FEW TO JUDGE. server/rejection_evidence.js summariseGate() iterates rows and prints "N episodes"; the `episode` field exists on every row and is never read. No gate moved on it. Also: VPS at 3/3 consecutive losses reporting halted:false (lazy check_circuit_breaker, mt5_bridge.py:1361 the only call site).
